query: We need a technical spec for rotating customer encryption keys without downtime. Inspect services/key-manager and make the migration and rollback explicit before anyone codes.
can you turn docs/checkout-brain-dump.md plus the whiteboard screenshot in docs/flow.png into something three coding agents can implement safely?
Review RFC-42 and tell me if it is actually ready for implementation; focus on unresolved product behavior and missing verification.
Scope the work for adding organization-level audit log export. I want the API contract, retention decisions, test evidence, rollout, and agent-sized slices, not code yet.
Our tickets disagree about whether deleted accounts keep invoices. Reconcile the sources into a mini-spec but don't pick a policy for us.
The implementation revealed that our accepted sync design cannot preserve ordering. Update the design spec and show which decisions and tasks are superseded.
Not enough evidence to choose Kafka versus a database outbox. Write a spike brief with an experiment and a decision rule.
Formalise these rough notes into a PRD/RFC for passkeys, including recovery and the password migration boundary.
Before we touch the schema, draft an implementation-ready migration proposal for splitting the orders table with compatibility and rollback.
This issue says 'make search fast with Elasticsearch'. Critique the framing and produce the smallest decision-ready issue contract without inventing a latency target.
Implement the accepted passkey spec in docs/passkeys.md, add tests, and run the existing verification commands.
The auth test started failing after yesterday's merge. Reproduce it, find the regression, fix it, and run the targeted suite.
Summarize RFC-42 in five bullets for the release channel. Do not critique or change it.
Review this pull request for correctness, security issues, and missing tests. Leave the design document alone.
Draw a Mermaid sequence diagram from the already accepted API flow in docs/contracts.md; no design changes needed.
Update the README installation section to use pnpm instead of npm and verify the links.
Explain what the existing ADR means by eventual consistency and give me a simple example.
Estimate how long the finalized notifications spec will take and assign the existing Linear issues to this sprint.
Brainstorm ten possible social features for the app; we are exploring ideas and do not want scope or a spec yet.
Run the migration described in docs/order-split.md on staging, monitor it, and roll back if the documented threshold is crossed.
